infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: IndiChat uses your contacts to find friends who are already on IndiChat. Your contacts are not stored on our servers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: IndiChat requires access to the camera to take and send photos and videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IndiChat requires access to your photo library to select and send photos and media.

infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: IndiChat uses Face ID for biometric security and authentication.
